parsed.rationale: Both participating records reside in test targets: `Shared/AppServices/Tests/AppServicesTests/NowPlayingServiceTests.swift` and `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkServiceTests.swift`. The shared name `MockArtworkService` in both files is a classic test-fixture pattern — each test target defines its own local mock to satisfy its own test isolation requirements. Merging or extracting these mocks into shared production or shared-test code would couple unrelated test suites and undermine isolation. Per the decision rules, any cluster where any participating record is a test file mandates no-action with reason_class 'test-fixture'.
